segments.en: The entire essential leaving Egypt and the giving of the Torah — and all the signs and the most awesome wonders that Hashem Yisburach performed with our ancestors and with us — from the day of the leaving of Egypt until this very day — in every generation and generation. All of it was in order to publicize His G-dliness (Yisburach). To know and to make known and to be known — that He is the Ruler — He is the Former — He is the Creator. Blessed and exalted be His name forever. For we merit to complete faith in truth — in the true Tzadik — who is the essential one of all the truly genuine Tzadikim.
